# Vendored file

`pr4281-witnesses.json` is a byte-identical copy of
`research/depth5-chain-connector/witnesses.json` from
[PR #4281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4281) at head
`87f4a21e02c83fab559dcf1470dd0a97dfb89b8f` (Git blob
`aebd77d7a68a7f7acfc9a56314528b58d8ca8875`). It is copied, not pinned, because that head is
not reachable from canonical main; `verify.py` checks its SHA256 and uses it only to list the
(m, c) pairs #4281 left open. Nick Petalas's work, Apache-2.0.
